senses.gloss: m. (fr. <cite ref="B00308"><he>בוץ</he></cite> to shine; orig. a plur. of <cite ref="B00308"><he>בּוּצָא</he></cite>)

units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on I Samuel 3:3">Targ. I Sam. III, 3</cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 3:4:2">Cant. R. to III, 4</cite> (expl.
<cite ref="Isaiah 21:5">Is. XXI, 5</cite>) <he>אקימת מנרתא אדליקת ב׳</he> thou hast put up the lamp, lighted the wicks.
<cite ref="Shabbat 30a:3">Sabb. 30ᵃ</cite> <he>לכבות ב׳ דנורא</he> to put out a lamp (Ms. M. omits <he>דנורא</he>).—

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 85:4">Gen. R. s. 85</cite> (play on <he>שוע</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 38:2">Gen. XXXVIII, 2</cite>, v. <cite ref="U01637"><he>שַׁעֲוָה</he></cite>) <he>ב׳ דאתרא</he> the light of the town (leader); a. fr.—Pl. <he>בּוֹצִינַיָּא</he>.
<cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 30:7">Targ. Ex. XXX, 7</cite> sq.; a. e.

senses.gloss: (in Bab. dialect; cmp. בטי) a young pumpkin, contrad. to קרא the full-grown one.
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 48a:3">Ber. 48ᵃ</cite> (prov.) <he>ב׳ ב׳ מקיניה ידיע</he> Ar. a. Rashi (ed. <he>מקטפיה</he>; Ms. M. <he>בוצינא מקיטפיה ידע</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) the young pumpkin is known by its shaft [by what oozes out of it, <he>מקיטפיה</he>], i.e. the future scholar is recognized by his utterings in childhood.
<cite ref="Sukkah 56b:1">Succ. 56ᵇ</cite> a young pumpkin (now) is better than a large one (later); (differ. in Tosaf. a. l.); a. e.—Pl. <he>בּוֹצִינַיָּא</he>, <he>בּוֹצִינֵי</he>.
<cite ref="Nedarim 66b:7">Ned. 66ᵇ</cite> (a misunderstanding of <he>בוציני</he> betw. a Babylonian husband and a Palestinean wife).
<cite ref="Yoma 78a">Yoma 78ᵃ</cite> <he>מצטנן בב׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>בינוקא</he>) cooled his hands with young pumpkins.—

<cite ref="Megillah 12a">Meg. 12ᵃ</cite> sq. (prov.) <he>איהו בקרי וכ׳</he> (Var. <he>בי וכו׳</he>; <cite ref="Sotah 10a:7">Sot. 10ᵃ</cite> <he>בי קארי וכ׳</he>) the husband between the old pumpkins, his wife between the young ones, i.e. a faithless husband makes a faithless wife.

senses.gloss: (from its shape) ב׳ דריחייא the pivot (Rashi); the hole (socket) in the lower millstone (Ar.).
